name: Keerthana K. B.
objective:
本課程旨在為學生奠定商業統計基礎，並闡述其在數據驅動決策中的作用。學生將學習如何收集、整理、視覺化和分析商業數據，解讀統計結果，並使用 Microsoft Excel 和 SPSS 進行數據分析和結果交流。課程著重透過商業案例研究和真實案例進行實踐應用。
This course provides students with a foundation in business statistics and its role in data-driven decision-making. Students will learn to collect, organize, visualize, and analyze business data, interpret statistical results, and communicate findings using Microsoft Excel and SPSS. The course emphasizes practical applications through business case studies and real-world examples.
schedule:
Week 1 Introduction to Business Statistics 
Week 2 Business Data & Data Collection 
Week 3 Organizing & Visualizing Data 
Week 4 Descriptive Statistics I (Mean, Median, Mode)
Week 5 Descriptive Statistics II (Variation & Distribution)
Week 6 Business Dashboard & Report Writing
Week 7 Introduction to Probability 
Week 8 Probability in Business 
Week 9 Midterm Examination 
Week 10 Probability Distributions 
Week 11 Normal Distribution 
Week 12 Sampling Methods 
Week 13 Sampling Distributions 
Week 14 Confidence Intervals 
Week 15 Business Decision Making 
Week 16 Group Statistical Exhibit 
Week 17 Sample Project Creation Course 
Week 18 Wrap-up & Final Examination
scorePolicy:
In-Class Exercises 20%
Business Dashboard & Report Writing 15%
Midterm Examination 25%
Group Presentation & Final exam 40%
materials:
Introductory Business Statistics (OpenStax)
“Holmes, A., Illowsky, B., & Dean, S. (2017). Introductory Business Statistics 2e. OpenStax.”
consultation: Consultation appointments can be made with prior confirmation by email.
